title: Ten More, Ten Less in Your Head

steps.body: On the shown 50–60–70 path, plus ten moves to the next ten and minus ten moves back. The zero ones stay fixed.
steps.narration: On the shown 50–60–70 path, plus ten moves to the next ten and minus ten moves back. The zero ones stay fixed.

widget.prompt: What is ten more than 56? Hop to find out.
widget.missFeedback: Start at 56 and count on 10: you land on 66.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 66 — ten more than 56 is 66; only the tens digit moved.

predict.prompt: What is ten more than 56, without counting by ones?
predict.reveal: Ten more means the tens digit goes up by one: 5 becomes 6, giving 66.
